mapper.sql:
directory.id, organizations.organization_code, organizations.organization_name, CASE directory.directory_type WHEN '0' THEN 'DEPARTMENT' WHEN '1' THEN 'DOCTOR' WHEN '2' THEN 'WARD' WHEN '3' THEN 'BED' END AS directory_type, directory.source_record_code, directory.source_record_name, directory.mnemonic_code, directory.category_name, directory.remark, directory.source_organization_code, (
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM md_hospital_directory_relation relation WHERE relation.organization_id = directory.organization_id AND relation.source_system_code = directory.source_system_code AND ( (directory.directory_type = '0' AND relation.relation_type = 'WARD_DEPARTMENT' AND relation.target_record_code = directory.source_record_code) OR (directory.directory_type = '1' AND relation.relation_type = 'DOCTOR_WARD' AND relation.source_record_code = directory.source_record_code) OR (directory.directory_type = '2' AND ( (relation.relation_type IN ('DOCTOR_WARD', 'BED_WARD') AND relation.target_record_code = directory.source_record_code) OR (relation.relation_type = 'WARD_DEPARTMENT' AND relation.source_record_code = directory.source_record_code))) OR (directory.directory_type = '3' AND relation.relation_type = 'BED_WARD' AND relation.source_record_code = directory.source_record_code) ) ) AS relation_count, directory.latest_batch_id, batches.batch_no AS latest_batch_no, directory.last_seen_at
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM md_hospital_directory directory INNER JOIN org_organization organizations ON organizations.id = directory.organization_id

SELECT FROM md_hospital_directory directory INNER JOIN org_organization organizations ON organizations.id = directory.organization_id INNER JOIN md_sync_batch batches ON batches.id = directory.latest_batch_id
ORDER BY directory.directory_type, directory.source_record_name, directory.source_record_code, directory.id OFFSET #{query.offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{query.pageSize} ROWS ONLY
